AdminFederation.title: Federation Management
AdminFederation.description: Oversee connected Fediverse library peers, trust policies, and the ActivityPub activity pipeline.
AdminFederation.peeringNoticeDesc: Adding a peer sets how your server handles requests and data from that library. For mutual federation, the remote server's administrator must also add your domain. Trust levels: Trusted (catalog metadata auto-fills empty fields, users can auto-accept friend requests), Untrusted (default for new peers; friend and loan requests allowed with manual user approval, catalog edits held for review), and Blocked (all friend, loan, and metadata exchanges rejected).
AdminFederation.addPeerReciprocalNote: New peers start as Untrusted. The remote server administrator must also register your instance domain on their end.
AdminFederation.discoverDesc: Probe a remote ActivityPub Fediverse instance using NodeInfo to establish federation and sync metadata.
AdminFederation.connectedDesc: Configure trust policies for connected instances. Metadata from trusted peers is automatically reconciled.
AdminFederation.noInstancesDesc: Add a remote library instance above to begin sharing metadata.
AdminFederation.removeDesc: Are you sure you want to remove {domain}? This will terminate metadata sync with this instance.
AdminFederation.accessRestrictedDesc: You do not have the config:federation permission required to manage ActivityPub federation settings.
AdminFederation.activityLogDesc: Auditable log of ActivityStreams messages delivered to and from connected Fediverse peers.
AdminFederation.noActivitiesDesc: Activities will appear here when connected peers send or receive messages.
AdminFederation.keyFingerprintDesc: SHA-256 fingerprint of the instance actor public key for Fediverse HTTP signature verification.
